description: Save a search under a name. Body: name, query (filter set), kind? ('atlas' → unified-search shape, else legacy Explorer filters). Requires a user API key. To watch new tenders of a saved tender search: subscribe to the MCP event saved_search.new_tenders when the client supports MCP events, else call get_new_tenders once a day.
name: save_search
title: Save a search
